knowledgeAnswers.rationale: Two or three matching measures, taken the same way, show progress. Many unrelated measures or opinion alone do not.
A progression is the harder version of a movement; a regression is the easier one.
The lesson places a workable group programme at a midpoint on the scale.

practicalCriteria: The learner chooses two or three measures for a sample goal and writes the method and schedule for each, and the assessor checks they match the goal
The learner writes a group template in which every movement has a regression, base and progression
The learner completes a four-week log extract and flags one pattern for a template change
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
evidenceRequired: Group template with three levels per movement
Log extract with a flagged pattern
stopWorkCriteria: Stop presenting body-composition estimates as health outcomes
Stop recording measurements without the member's agreement
